correctness.rationale: There are 64 upper-triangular binary 3 by 3 matrices. Exactly the eight matrices with all three diagonal entries equal to one are units; in a finite ring every other element is a zero-divisor, leaving 55 nonzero standard vertices. Independent brute-force multiplication verified a nonzero one-sided annihilator for every such vertex, tested AB=0 or BA=0 on all 1485 unordered pairs to obtain 420 edges, and exact BFS from every vertex gave diameter two. The current 2025 source text independently confirms that its host retains only 27 matrices.
